title.neden: The title is the clickable line in search results; it is the first thing that tells both Google and users what the page is about, and it directly affects click-through rate.
title.duzelt: Give every page one unique <title> about 30–60 characters wide, with the main keyword near the start; put the brand name at the end.

aciklama.neden: The description often appears under the title in search results; it tells users why they should open the page and increases clicks.
aciklama.duzelt: Add one page-specific meta description about 70–160 characters wide with a call to action; don't reuse the same description across many pages.

canonical.neden: If the same content can be opened at several URLs, the canonical says which one is the main page so ranking signals are consolidated on one URL.
canonical.duzelt: Add exactly one absolute <link rel=canonical> (starting with https://) in the <head> pointing to the page's own clean URL.

robots_meta.neden: A page with noindex does not appear in Google; nofollow stops the page's links from passing value. A noindex left by mistake can wipe out traffic.
robots_meta.duzelt: Remove noindex / nofollow from the robots meta tag and the X-Robots-Tag header on pages you want to appear in search.

viewport.neden: Google evaluates the mobile version of your site. Without a viewport the page looks like a shrunken desktop page on phones; disabling zoom hurts accessibility.
viewport.duzelt: Use <meta name=viewport content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1.

lang.neden: The html lang attribute tells browsers, screen readers and search engines the page's language; a wrong language leads to wrong pronunciation and wrong targeting.
lang.duzelt: Add a valid language code such as <html lang="en">; use en-GB or tr-TR for regional versions.

hreflang.neden: On multilingual sites hreflang makes sure each user is shown the page in their language and prevents language versions from being treated as duplicates.
hreflang.duzelt: Every language version should list all versions, including itself, plus an x-default with valid codes (en, de, de-AT…); the list must be the same on every version.

og_etiketleri.neden: When a link is shared, the title, description and URL are read from these tags; if they are missing the platform may pick random text from the page.
og_etiketleri.duzelt: Add og:title, og:description, og:url and og:type to the <head>, written exactly as you want them to appear when shared.

twitter_karti.neden: twitter:card decides whether the link is shown on X with a small or a large image card.
twitter_karti.duzelt: Add <meta name=twitter:card content=summary_large_image>; the Open Graph tags are enough for the title, description and image.

og_gorsel.neden: Posts with images get far more clicks. If the image doesn't load, is too small or too heavy, the platform shows the card without an image.
og_gorsel.duzelt: Provide a JPG/PNG/WebP image with an absolute https URL, 1200×630 pixels and under 5 MB as og:image, and make sure the URL is public.

jsonld_sozdizimi.neden: A single comma error makes the whole block unreadable; search engines can't use any information in it.
jsonld_sozdizimi.duzelt: Fix the line and column shown (trailing comma, missing quote, unescaped character) and use https://schema.org as @context.

jsonld_turler.neden: Structured data tells machines what the page is about (business, product, article, FAQ…) and opens the door to rich results and AI answers.
jsonld_turler.duzelt: Add the schema.org type that fits the content as JSON-LD: Organization/LocalBusiness and WebSite on the home page, Article on posts, Product on product pages.

jsonld_alanlar.neden: An item missing a required field is not eligible for rich results; recommended fields decide how rich the result looks.
jsonld_alanlar.duzelt: Fill the listed missing fields with information that is actually visible on the page; never put information in structured data that isn't on the page.

robots_dosyasi.neden: Crawlers start every site by reading robots.txt. If the file returns a 5xx error, Google may stop crawling the site for a while.
robots_dosyasi.duzelt: Publish a robots.txt in the root that returns 200 as plain text (text/plain) and is smaller than 500 KiB; it must not return an HTML page.

robots_yol.neden: The content of a blocked page can't be read; accidentally blocking important pages or CSS/JS files lowers rankings.
robots_yol.duzelt: Remove the Disallow rule that blocks the path you want crawled, or open it with a longer (more specific) Allow rule.

robots_sitemap.neden: A Sitemap line in robots.txt lets every search engine find your sitemap without submitting it separately.
robots_sitemap.duzelt: Add a Sitemap: https://yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml line with an absolute URL at the end of robots.txt.

robots_sozdizimi.neden: Unrecognised directives and rules written before a User-agent are ignored; the file doesn't work the way you think.
robots_sozdizimi.duzelt: Start every group with a User-agent line; use only User-agent, Allow, Disallow and Sitemap. Google ignores Crawl-delay.

sitemap_erisim.neden: A sitemap tells search engines which pages exist and when they changed, so new pages are discovered faster.
sitemap_erisim.duzelt: Publish the XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml with status 200, declare it in robots.txt and submit it in Search Console.

sitemap_bicim.neden: A malformed sitemap, or one that exceeds the limits, is read partially or not at all.
sitemap_bicim.duzelt: The root element must be urlset or sitemapindex with the namespace http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9; stay under 50,000 URLs and 50 MB per file.

sitemap_adresler.neden: Invalid, duplicate or off-domain URLs are ignored by search engines and reduce trust in the sitemap.
sitemap_adresler.duzelt: List each absolute, canonical URL on the same domain that returns 200 exactly once.

sitemap_lastmod.neden: An accurate lastmod lets Google crawl changed pages first; wrong or future dates make Google ignore the signal entirely.
sitemap_lastmod.duzelt: Use W3C format (2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T10:00:00+03:00) and update lastmod only when the content really changes.

sitemap_orneklem.neden: URLs in the sitemap that return 404, 5xx or redirects waste crawl budget and show the sitemap is out of date.
sitemap_orneklem.duzelt: Fix or remove the failing URLs; replace redirected URLs with the final URL that returns 200.

zincir.neden: Every redirect step slows down loading and wastes crawl budget; a URL stuck in a loop never opens.
zincir.duzelt: Redirect every old URL in a single step (301) straight to the final URL; remove intermediate steps and loops.

son_durum.neden: A page that doesn't return 200 at the end of the chain can't be indexed, and visitors see an error page.
son_durum.duzelt: Make sure the page really exists; if it moved, redirect it with 301; if it was removed, use 410 or redirect to the closest page.

https_yonlendirme.neden: If the unencrypted http version stays open, users may land on an insecure page and the same page is indexed at two URLs.
https_yonlendirme.duzelt: In your server or CDN settings, send all http requests to https in one step with a permanent (301/308) redirect.

www_tutarlilik.neden: If both the www and non-www URLs open separately, the site looks like a copy of itself and link equity is split.
www_tutarlilik.duzelt: Choose one as primary (e.g. https://yourdomain.com) and 301-redirect the other three variants (http, www) to it.

hsts.neden: HSTS tells the browser to connect to the site over https only, preventing the unencrypted first request from being hijacked.
hsts.duzelt: Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains to https responses (try a short duration first).

csp.neden: CSP limits where scripts can be loaded from; it is the strongest defence against XSS. unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval weaken this protection.
csp.duzelt: Write a Content-Security-Policy listing your own domain and the services you actually use; allow inline scripts with a nonce or hash. Try it with Report-Only first.

frame.neden: Without it your site can be embedded in another page in an invisible frame and users tricked into clicking (clickjacking).
frame.duzelt: Add frame-ancestors 'self' to your CSP or send X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN.

nosniff.neden: Without nosniff the browser may guess the file type and run a harmless-looking file as a script.
nosniff.duzelt: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to every response and serve files with the correct Content-Type.

referrer.neden: This header decides what address information is sent to the other site when a link is clicked; weak values can leak personal data in page URLs.
referrer.duzelt: Use Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or the stricter no-referrer / same-origin).

permissions.neden: It limits which pages may use browser features such as camera, microphone and location, preventing embedded third-party content from abusing them.
permissions.duzelt: Turn off features you don't use, e.g. Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=().

sunucu_bilgisi.neden: Version numbers in the Server and X-Powered-By headers make it easier for attackers to target known vulnerabilities.
sunucu_bilgisi.duzelt: Hide version information in your server settings (e.g. nginx server_tokens off) and remove the X-Powered-By header.

sertifika_gecerlilik.neden: With an invalid, expired or mismatched certificate the browser shows a full-page warning and most visitors leave.
sertifika_gecerlilik.duzelt: Install a certificate from a trusted authority that covers the domain (and www); a free, auto-renewing option such as Let's Encrypt is enough.

sertifika_suresi.neden: The moment the certificate expires the site looks untrusted; a forgotten renewal makes traffic drop instantly.
sertifika_suresi.duzelt: Enable automatic renewal and set up monitoring that warns you at least 30 days before expiry.

tls_surumu.neden: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are insecure and disabled by browsers; TLS 1.3 is faster and more secure.
tls_surumu.duzelt: Keep TLS 1.2 and 1.3 enabled on the server and 1.0 and 1.1 disabled.

ssl_zincir.neden: If an intermediate certificate is missing, some browsers, especially mobile devices and bots, won't trust the site.
ssl_zincir.duzelt: Install the full chain (fullchain) provided by the issuer on the server, not just the site certificate.

h1.neden: The H1 is the strongest on-page heading telling visitors and search engines the page's main topic.
h1.duzelt: Use one non-empty H1 per page that clearly states the topic; don't make a logo or decorative text the H1.

baslik_hiyerarsi.neden: Ordered headings (H2 → H3) split the content into sections; screen readers and search engines read the page structure from them.
baslik_hiyerarsi.duzelt: Don't skip levels (H3 after H2, not H4), don't leave empty headings, and use headings for meaning, not for visual size.

icerik_uzunlugu.neden: Pages with very little text don't cover the topic sufficiently, are treated as thin content and rank poorly.
icerik_uzunlugu.duzelt: Add original text that fits the page's purpose and answers visitors' questions; more than 300 words is a good start for main pages.

anahtar_yogunlugu.neden: Excessive repetition of one word makes the text unnatural and can be seen as spam.
anahtar_yogunlugu.duzelt: Use the main keyword in the heading and first paragraph, then write naturally with synonyms and related phrases.

hedef_kelime.neden: The text should make clear which search the page answers; if the phrase never appears or is repeated excessively, the page looks weak or unnatural for that search.
hedef_kelime.duzelt: Use the phrase naturally in the opening paragraph and in a suitable subheading; broaden the topic in the rest of the text with synonyms and related phrases.

hedef_konum.neden: The title, the H1, the meta description and the URL are where search engines and users first see what the page is about.
hedef_konum.duzelt: Use the target phrase near the start of the title, in the H1 and naturally in the meta description; pick a short, readable URL for new pages (e.g. /seo-agency). If you change an existing URL, add a 301 redirect.
